name: Meta Platforms
description: Meta sells advertising on Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp and Threads, reaching 3.60 billion people a day (June 2026 average). Advertising is 97.6 percent of revenue; advertisers bid for placement and pay per impression or action. A second segment, Reality Labs (Quest headsets, Ray-Ban Meta AI glasses, augmented and virtual reality software), sells hardware at a small revenue base and lost $19.2B in FY2025 and $4.6B in Q2 2026. The family of apps earns a 38.8 percent operating margin (Q2 2026) that pays for Reality Labs and a very large AI infrastructure build: 2026 capital spending is guided at $130B to $145B against $72.2B in 2025. Profit fell 8 percent in Q2 2026 even though revenue grew 28 percent.
